changes.now: Loki builds an army of villains to conquer Earth, and Spider-Man and S.H.I.E.L.D. keep knocking them down, until Loki raises the stakes with Venom's powers.
changes.proposed: Loki builds an army of overloaded villains to take Asgard's throne, and Spider-Man and S.H.I.E.L.D. keep knocking them down, until Thor, Spider-Man and Iron Man take the fight to Loki in Asgard.
changes.evidence: Loki, from his snow fort in Asgard, overloads villains (Doctor Octopus, Venom, the Mandarin, the Abomination) with Nornfrost snowballs; Venom is just the episode 2 overload, beaten at the Daily Bugle and jailed on the Helicarrier. In episode 5 Loki reveals his plan is an army of overloads to take the throne of Asgard; Thor brings Spider-Man and Iron Man to Asgard, Loki overloads himself with Nornfrost (not Venom's powers) and is beaten.

changes.now: Loki and the Frost Giants threaten the holidays, and the Avengers and Spider-Man step in to save them. On the TVA's monitors, Earth-TRN838 is marked terminated.
changes.proposed: Loki and the Frost Giants threaten the holidays, and the Avengers step in to save them. On the TVA's monitors, Earth-TRN838 is marked terminated.
changes.evidence: Spider-Man does not appear in Frost Fight!. The heroes are the Avengers (Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Captain Marvel) with Reptil, Rocket Raccoon and Groot, against Loki and the Frost Giant Ymir, who plan to steal Santa Claus's powers.

changes.now: The Avengers are getting ready for a party at Stark Tower when Iron Man starts acting strangely. Ultron has taken control of him and his armor, and the team has to get him back.
changes.proposed: The Avengers are getting ready for a party at Avengers Tower when Iron Man starts acting strangely. Ultron has taken control of him and his armor, and the team has to get him back.
changes.evidence: The special is a retelling of Age of Ultron; the party and the final battle take place at Avengers Tower (listed as Avengers Tower in episodes 1 and 5).
